name: Ramco Systems Limited
summary: Ramco Systems Limited operates as an enterprise software company in the United States, Europe, the Asia-Pacific, India, and the Middle East, and Africa. The company provides aviation, aerospace & defense that includes maintenance, repair, and overhaul; engine MRO; maintenance & engineering; defense asset management; flight operations; and feet technical management. The company also offers ERP, including enterprise asset management, production, finance, and supply chain, project and facility management.
